og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 12 in a year. In 47% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 136 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 23, 7:45 PM ET.

n.title: Amodei says Anthropic held its Mythos-class models back four months for cyber safeguards, maybe costing a lead
n.summary: Dario Amodei says Anthropic held Mythos-class models back four months to build cyber safeguards, conceding it may have cost a lead.
